arxiv-1510-07339.title: Tunable transport of drops on a vibrating inclined fiber
arxiv-1510-07339.creator: Alison Bick, François Boulogne, Alban Sauret, Howard A. Stone
arxiv-1510-07339.description: Abstract Transport of liquid drops in fibrous media occurs in various engineering systems such as fog harvesting or cleaning of textiles. The ability to tune or to control liquid movement can increase the system efficiency and enable new engineering applications.

arxiv-2012-04237.title: Quantum-to-classical transition via quantum cellular automata
arxiv-2012-04237.creator: Pedro C.S. Costa
arxiv-2012-04237.description: Abstract A quantum cellular automaton (QCA) is an abstract model consisting of an array of finite-dimensional quantum systems that evolves in discrete time by local unitary operations. Here we propose a simple coarse-graining map, where the spatial structure of the QCA is merged into effective ones.

arxiv-2101-07794.title: On Monte-Carlo methods in convex stochastic optimization
arxiv-2101-07794.creator: Daniel Bartl, Shahar Mendelson
arxiv-2101-07794.description: Abstract . We develop a novel procedure for estimating the optimizer of general convex stochastic optimization problems of the form min x ∈ 𝒳 ⁡ 𝔼 ⁡ [ F ⁡ ( x , ξ ) ] \min_{x\in\mathcal{X}}\mathbb{E}[F(x,\xi)] , when the given data is a finite independent sample selected according to ξ \xi .

arxiv-2112-07109.title: Hybrid Quantum Benders’ Decomposition For Mixed-integer Linear Programming
arxiv-2112-07109.creator: Zhongqi Zhao 1,2 , Lei Fan 2 , and Zhu Han 1
arxiv-2112-07109.description: Abstract The Benders’ decomposition algorithm is a technique in mathematical programming for complex mixed-integer linear programming (MILP) problems with a particular block structure. The strategy of Benders’ decomposition can be described as a strategy of divide and conquer. The Benders’ decomposition algorithm has been employed in a variety of applications such as communication, networking, and machine learning.

arxiv-2302-03067.title: Memory-Based Meta-Learning on Non-Stationary Distributions
arxiv-2302-03067.creator: Tim Genewein, Grégoire Delétang, Anian Ruoss, Li Kevin Wenliang, Elliot Catt, Vincent Dutordoir, Jordi Grau-Moya, Laurent Orseau, Marcus Hutter, Joel Veness
arxiv-2302-03067.description: Abstract Memory-based meta-learning is a technique for approximating Bayes-optimal predictors. Under fairly general conditions, minimizing sequential prediction error, measured by the log loss, leads to implicit meta-learning. The goal of this work is to investigate how far this interpretation can be realized by current sequence prediction models and training regimes.

arxiv-2402-16369.title: Generative AI in Vision: A Survey on Models, Metrics and Applications
arxiv-2402-16369.creator: Gaurav Raut, Apoorv Singh
arxiv-2402-16369.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gaurav Raut, Apoorv Singh. Generative AI models have revolutionized various fields by enabling the creation of realistic and diverse data samples. Among these models, diffusion models have emerged as a powerful approach for generating high-quality images, text, and audio. This survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of generative AI diffusion and legacy models, focusing on their underlying techniques, applications across different domains, and their challenges.

arxiv-2406-14709.title: Factual Dialogue Summarization via Learning from Large Language Models
arxiv-2406-14709.creator: Rongxin Zhu, Jey Han Lau, Jianzhong Qi
arxiv-2406-14709.description: Abstract Factual consistency is an important quality in dialogue summarization. Large language model (LLM)-based automatic text summarization models generate more factually consistent summaries compared to those by smaller pretrained language models, but they face deployment challenges in real-world applications due to privacy or resource constraints.

arxiv-2407-17796.title: Eigenbasis for a weighted adjacency matrix associated with the projective geometry B q ​ ( n ) B_{q}(n)
arxiv-2407-17796.creator: Murali K. Srinivasan
arxiv-2407-17796.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Murali K. Srinivasan. In a recent article Projective geometries, Q Q -polynomial structures, and quantum groups Terwilliger (arXiv:2407.14964) defined a certain weighted adjacency matrix, depending on a free (positive real) parameter, associated with the projective geometry, and showed (among many other results) that it is diagonalizable, with the eigenvalues and their multiplicities explicitly written down, and that it satisfies the Q Q -polynomial property (with respect to the zero subspace). In this note we • Write down an explicit eigenbasis for this matrix.

arxiv-2411-16664.title: Slope Semistability of Veronese normal bundles
arxiv-2411-16664.creator: Ray Shang
arxiv-2411-16664.description: Abstract . A classical fact is that normal bundles of rational normal curves are well-balanced. We generalize this by proving that all Veronese normal bundles are slope semistable. We also determine the line bundle decomposition of the restriction of degree 2 Veronese normal bundles to lines and rational normal curves. 1.

arxiv-2506-04464.creator: Oussama Ben Sghaier, Rosalia Tufano, Gabriele Bavota, Houari Sahraoui
arxiv-2506-04464.description: Abstract . Code review is a crucial component of modern software development, involving the evaluation of code quality, providing feedback on potential issues, and refining the code to address identified problems. Despite these benefits, code review can be rather time consuming, and influenced by subjectivity and human factors.

arxiv-2507-15845.title: Quantum computational sensing using quantum signal processing, quantum neural networks, and Hamiltonian engineering
arxiv-2507-15845.creator: Saeed A. Khan, Sridhar Prabhu, Logan G. Wright, Peter L. McMahon
arxiv-2507-15845.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Saeed A. Khan, Sridhar Prabhu, Logan G. Wright, Peter L. McMahon. Combining quantum sensing with quantum computing can lead to quantum computational sensors that are able to more efficiently extract task-specific information from physical signals than is possible otherwise. Early examples of quantum computational sensing (QCS) have largely focused on protocols where only a single sensing operation appears before measurement—with an exception being the recent application of Grover’s algorithm to signal detection.

arxiv-2509-19656.title: Anisotropic momentum distributions due to radiation recoil in relativistic plasmas with electric and magnetic fields
arxiv-2509-19656.creator: Haidar Al-Naseri
arxiv-2509-19656.description: Abstract The interaction of strong electromagnetic fields with plasma generates radiation accompanied by a recoil force, which can significantly alter the plasma dynamics. In this work, we investigate the development of anisotropic momentum distributions induced by the combined action of electric and magnetic fields on a thermally relativistic plasma. We consider three distinct types of anisotropy.

arxiv-2602-13456.title: Shunt-controlled resistive state of superconducting wires
arxiv-2602-13456.creator: K. Harrabi, Z. Alzoubi, L. R. Cadorim, M. V. Milošević
arxiv-2602-13456.description: Abstract The use of resistive shunts in superconducting electronics is vast and versatile, to dampen oscillations in junctions, stabilize switching behavior, aid current sensing, divert current during quenches, and protect both the superconductor and the circuit from damage. In single-photon detection by superconducting nanowires, the shunt is crucial for the timely relaxation of the sensor between the events to detect.

arxiv-2606-22034.title: Auditing Combinatorial Randomness from Finite Transcripts
arxiv-2606-22034.creator: Faruk AlpayLevent SarıogluDepartment of Computer Engineering, Bahcesehir University, Istanbul, Turkey faruk.alpay@bahcesehir.edu.tr , levent.sarioglu@bahcesehir.edu.tr

pmc-10739408.title: Inheritance pattern of tetraploids pummelo, mandarin, and their interspecific hybrid sour orange is highly influenced by their phylogenomic structure
pmc-10739408.creator: Pablo Aleza, Miguel Fernando Garavello, Houssem Rouiss, Ana Cristina Benedict, Andres Garcia-Lor, Maria Hernández, Luis Navarro, Patrick Ollitrault
pmc-10739408.description: Citrus polyploidy is associated with a wide range of morphological, genetic, and physiological changes that are often advantageous for breeding. Citrus triploid hybrids are very interesting as new seedless varieties. However, tetraploid rootstocks promote adaptation to different abiotic stresses and promote resilience.

pmc-10761012.title: Acquired resistance to crizotinib in novel CDK14-ALK and CLTC-ALK fusions of ALK-positive large B-cell lymphoma identified by next-generation sequencing
pmc-10761012.creator: Yuxue Xia, Lu Zhang, Wenjuan He, Huaxiong Pan, Jun Fang, Guohui Cui
pmc-10761012.description: Anaplastic lymphoma kinase-positive large B-cell lymphoma (ALK+ LBCL) is a rare subtype of non-Hodgkin lymphoma. ALK inhibitors are being tried to treat recurrent/refractory ALK+ LBCL. A majority of patients with ALK+ tumors respond to crizotinib, but partial cases ultimately develop resistance about a year later.

pmc-11182298.title: Case report: Pemigatinib-induced retinopathy: a serial examination of subretinal fluid secondary to an FGFR inhibitor
pmc-11182298.creator: Daniel Barmas-Alamdari, George Jiao, Ronni Lieberman
pmc-11182298.description: BackgroundModern chemotherapeutic agents continue to evolve as modern monoclonal antibody treatments are designed to directly target proteins, enzymes, and focal loci. A particular class of these medications, fibroblast growth factor (FGFR) inhibitors, specifically pemigatinib (Pemazyre®; Incyte), has been approved by the US Food and Drug Administration since April 2020 for the treatment of advanced or metastatic cholangiocarcinoma.

pmc-11517340.title: Representativeness of disadvantaged pupils in a trial to improve beverage consumption in Belgium
pmc-11517340.creator: L Desbouys, W Assakali, I Thiébaut, K Castetbon
pmc-11517340.description: BackgroundThe cluster-randomized controlled trial DRINK was implemented in 2021 to evaluate the effect of interventions aimed at reducing sweetened beverages and increasing tap water consumption among children in French-speaking primary schools in Belgium. Multiple participation issues related to the implementation in the school setting were encountered.

pmc-11973430.title: Rubisco packaging and stoichiometric composition of the native β-carboxysome in Synechococcus elongatus PCC7942
pmc-11973430.creator: Yaqi Sun, Yuewen Sheng, Tao Ni, Xingwu Ge, Joscelyn Sarsby, Philip J Brownridge, Kang Li, Nathan Hardenbrook, Gregory F Dykes, Nichola Rockliffe, Claire E Eyers, Peijun Zhang, Lu-Ning Liu
pmc-11973430.description: Carboxysomes are anabolic bacterial microcompartments that play an essential role in CO2 fixation in cyanobacteria. This self-assembling proteinaceous organelle uses a polyhedral shell constructed by hundreds of shell protein paralogs to encapsulate the key CO2-fixing enzymes Rubisco and carbonic anhydrase.

pmc-12406463.title: The osteogenic effect of 3D-printed bone grafting guides in PAOO: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-12406463.creator: Han Bao, Yiran Luo, Qingfei He, Yan Jiang, Ling Chen, Yun Wu
pmc-12406463.description: BackgroundPeriodontally accelerated osteogenic orthodontics (PAOO) effectively increases alveolar bone volume and broadens orthodontic treatment options. However, bone grafting during PAOO faces challenges such as graft displacement, membrane collapse, and insufficient coronal bone regeneration. This study aimed to evaluate whether 3D-printed digital bone grafting guides could improve graft stability and alveolar bone regeneration compared with conventional PAOO.

pmc-12517026.title: Exploring the lived experiences of first blood among adolescent girls in Pakistan: a phenomenological qualitative study
pmc-12517026.creator: Ruhma Binte Shahzad, Muhammad Mohsin Aftab, Hamda Shahzad, Javeria Saleem, Mehnaz Rashid, Mohsin Arshad, Saira Abbas
pmc-12517026.description: AbstractObjectiveThe study aims to explore the experiences of adolescent girls with the onset of their first menstruation in the context of Pakistan and to highlight the sociocultural aspects that shape those experiences.DesignThe study employs an exploratory phenomenological approach.SettingThis study has been conducted at a public sector higher education institute, University of the Punjab, Pakistan.

pmc-12617193.title: OA2019. Poor correlation between sources on vulnerable road users: Examples from Luxembourg and Denmark
pmc-12617193.creator: K Kjaergaard, J Pastore
pmc-12617193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundRoad safety is a major global concern and is the subject of attention from national, trans-national, and global agencies and bureaus in order to achieve a lower number of injuries and fatalities in road traffic.

pmc-12661989.title: Enhancing full-thickness skin graft take in nipple reconstruction using PICO™ negative pressure therapy: A technical note
pmc-12661989.creator: Marco Palmesano, Gabriele Storti, Irene Nunziata, Riccardo Foti, Carlo Cossi, Valerio Cervelli
pmc-12661989.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Nipple-areola complex (NAC) necrosis remains a challenging complication following nipple-sparing mastectomy, with significant emotional and aesthetic consequences for patients. Full-thickness skin grafting (FTSG) offers a viable reconstructive option in secondary procedures. We report our experience using PICO™ single-use negative pressure wound therapy (NPWT), applied directly over the breast, to enhance graft take in three consecutive cases of nipple reconstruction using groin-derived FTSG.

pmc-12755938.title: Is Anxiety Associated with Vasomotor Symptoms in Postmenopausal Women with Insomnia Complaints?
pmc-12755938.creator: Leandro Lucena, Beatriz Hachul de Campos, Letícia Dimov, Sergio Tufik, Helena Hachul
pmc-12755938.description: ObjectiveThis study investigated the relationship between hot flashes, menopausal symptoms, anxiety, depression, and insomnia in postmenopausal women with insomnia complaints.MethodsA cross-sectional analysis was conducted with 71 postmenopausal women experiencing insomnia, divided into two groups based on the presence of vasomotor symptoms: 41 participants reported hot flashes in the past month, while 30 did not.

pmc-13453402.title: Chronic Spontaneous Urticaria with Biochemical C1 Inhibitor Deficiency: A Case Report of Suspected Overlap with Hereditary Angioedema
pmc-13453402.creator: Fang Chen, Fan Yang, Xiao Li, Tianhao Li
pmc-13453402.description: RationaleChronic spontaneous urticaria (CSU) and hereditary angioedema caused by C1 inhibitor (C1-INH) deficiency are mechanistically distinct disorders. When persistent wheals coexist with recurrent throat or abdominal symptoms, however, assigning individual episodes to mast-cell- or bradykinin-mediated pathways can be difficult.Patient ConcernsA 36-year-old Chinese woman developed recurrent wheals and pruritus in 2020.

pmc-13551546.title: Exploring the Practices of Healthcare Practitioners During the Implementation of a Healthy Eating Policy
pmc-13551546.creator: Laura J Kennedy, Jeanna Parsons Leigh, Sara F L Kirk, Meaghan Sim, Catherine L Mah
pmc-13551546.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Health promotion policy is an effective way to improve population health and reduce the burden of chronic disease, yet how implementation of health promotion at policy levels occurs within healthcare remains unclear. Healthcare organizations, on the one hand, aim to improve population health and ‘upstream’ health determinants through the Quintuple Aim, but, on the other, are complex and dynamic organizations, with a particular emphasis on downstream clinical care services.

pmc-13673569.title: Associations Between Perceived Knowledge, Interprofessional Collaboration, Autonomy and the Frequency of Nursing Activities in Paediatric Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation: A Cross‐Sectional Study
pmc-13673569.creator: Semyon Melnikov, Reem Abed Elhai, Nashaat Hijazi, Nagah Zaid, Alex Furmanov
pmc-13673569.description: BackgroundExtracorporeal membrane oxygenation (ECMO) requires coordinated multidisciplinary care. Although registered nurses (RNs) play a critical role, evidence on factors associated with the frequency of ECMO‐related nursing activities in paediatric settings remains limited.AimTo examine associations between perceived ECMO knowledge, interprofessional collaboration, nursing autonomy and the frequency of ECMO‐related nursing activities.Study DesignA multicentre cross‐sectional study was conducted.
